With these changes:

- The `role` prop is no longer part of Tabs’ API or default props.
- The rendered outer `<div>` no longer has `role="navigation"`.
- Storybook knobs no longer encourage the old `navigation` role.
- Authors who need a navigation landmark can still wrap `<Tabs>` in a `<nav>` of their choosing.
